verdict.rationale: Remote is a global payroll and EOR platform, so paying employees by fast direct deposit is a fair question for it. The evidence only mentions global payroll in general terms, contractor invoice auto-pay, and payslip downloads. Nothing documents direct deposit to employees or next-day or 2-day payment timing.

support.subject: As a founder, I can pay employees by fast (next-day or 2-day) direct deposit instead of writing checks
